blocks.en: A ship or spaceship in EVE Online is a vehicle used to travel in space, battle enemy forces, ferry materials and products, provide logistical services, and for many other purposes.
blocks.zh: EVE Online 中的舰船或飞船是一种载具，可用于在太空中航行、与敌对势力作战、运送原材料和产品、提供后勤服务，以及许多其他用途。

blocks.en: A ship may be piloted by a capsuleer (player) or non-player characters such as CONCORD, faction militaries, civilian industrialists, or outlawed paramilitary and pirate forces.
blocks.zh: 舰船可以由克隆飞行员（玩家）驾驶，也可以由非玩家角色驾驶，例如统合部、各势力军队、民间工业家，或者非法的准军事组织和海盗势力。

blocks.en: Mechanics
blocks.zh: 机制

blocks.en: A ship's defenses and durability are represented by its shield, armor and structure hitpoints. Certain NPC vessels lack shields, but all capsuleer ships have all three defensive systems, including capsules themselves. These hitpoints are used for tanking incoming damage. Nearly all ships have module slots, allowing them to fit modules such as (but not limited to) weapons, armor repairers, shield boosters, armor plates, electronic warfare devices, cloaks, rigs and propulsion equipment.
blocks.zh: 舰船的防御能力和耐久度由护盾、装甲和结构值来体现。某些 NPC 舰船没有护盾，但所有克隆飞行员的舰船都具备全部三层防御，太空舱本身也不例外。这些耐久值用于承受（坦）受到的伤害。几乎所有舰船都有装备槽位，可以装配各种装备，包括（但不限于）武器、装甲维修器、护盾回充增量器、装甲板、电子战设备、隐形装置、改装件和推进装备。

blocks.en: All ships have capacitor banks, similar to a gigantic battery. The engines charge these batteries and the accumulated energy is used to run active modules and power warp drives.
blocks.zh: 所有舰船都有电容组，类似于一块巨大的电池。引擎为这些电池充能，积累的能量用于运行主动装备和驱动跃迁引擎。

blocks.en: Ships move in local space by using their engines, almost always located at the ship's stern. This local movement does not use capacitor energy, although using afterburner or microwarpdrive modules to speed the ship up does.
blocks.zh: 舰船在本地空间中依靠引擎移动，引擎几乎总是位于舰尾。这种本地移动不消耗电容能量，不过使用加力燃烧器或微型跃迁推进器来提速则会消耗电容。

blocks.en: "Military experts are calling this a 'cynosural field'."—Journalist during the start of the Gallente–Caldari War in YC110
blocks.zh: “军事专家称之为‘诱导力场’。”——YC110 年盖伦特-加达里战争爆发时的一名记者

blocks.en: To move longer distances within solar systems, ships use warp drives. Starting warp requires a destination object with mass or feigned mass. The ship will acquire this object as a target and use its warp drive in conjunction with sub-lightspeed thrusters to accelerate through a warp tunnel.
blocks.zh: 要在星系内进行较远距离的移动，舰船使用跃迁引擎。启动跃迁需要一个有质量或伪质量的目的地物体。舰船会把该物体作为目标，利用跃迁引擎配合亚光速推进器，在跃迁通道中加速前进。

blocks.en: To travel the great distances between solar systems, ships use stargates, wormholes, and certain types of filament. Capital class ships can also use built-in jump drives to travel these great distances, by locking onto the beacon of a cynosural field at their destination.
blocks.zh: 要穿越星系之间的遥远距离，舰船会使用星门、虫洞以及某些类型的纤维。旗舰级舰船还可以使用内置的跳跃引擎，锁定目的地诱导力场的信标来跨越这些遥远距离。

blocks.en: All ships except supercapitals can be built in and docked in stations. Most ships have a cargo hold, many ships have drone bays, and some ships have specialized cargoholds, ship maintenance bays and fuel bays.
blocks.zh: 除超级旗舰外，所有舰船都可以在空间站中建造和停靠。大多数舰船都有货柜舱，许多舰船有无人机舱，有些舰船还有专用货舱、舰船维护舱和燃料舱。

blocks.en: Skills
blocks.zh: 技能

blocks.en: Spaceship command skills
blocks.zh: 飞船操控技能

blocks.en: The Sin, a Black Ops Battleship which requires months of training to fly.
blocks.zh: 罪恶级，一艘需要数月训练才能驾驶的黑隐特勤舰。

blocks.en: To fly ships in EVE, a character must train the relevant skills in the Spaceship Command skill category. This category is not to be confused with the general skill Spaceship Command.
blocks.zh: 在 EVE 中驾驶舰船，角色必须训练飞船操控学技能类别中的相关技能。不要把这个类别和通用技能飞船操控学混淆。

blocks.en: The skills for larger hull types and higher tech levels usually require some skill training in smaller hull types or lower tech levels first. To fly a Tech 1 cruiser, for instance, you must first have some training in a Tech 1 destroyer command skill. Likewise, the skills for Tech 2 frigates require perfecting the Tech 1 frigate command skills.
blocks.zh: 更大舰体类型和更高科技等级的舰船技能，通常需要先训练一些较小舰体类型或较低科技等级的技能。例如，要驾驶 T1 巡洋舰，必须先训练一定等级的 T1 驱逐舰操作技能。同样，T2 护卫舰的技能要求把 T1 护卫舰操作技能练满。

blocks.en: In most cases, the prerequisites for flying bigger ships (by hull type) are faster to train than the prerequisites for higher tech levels. As a result, newer pilots may find themselves in large T1 ships (battlecruisers or battleships) long before they can fly a T2 ship of any size. This is not a hard-and-fast rule, though: it's reasonable to train straight from Tech 1 frigates into Tech 2 frigates, for instance, without ever training the skills required to fly larger Tech 1 ships, if that is your goal as a pilot.
blocks.zh: 大多数情况下，驾驶更大舰船（按舰体类型）的前置技能，比驾驶更高科技等级舰船的前置技能训练得更快。因此，新飞行员往往远在能驾驶任何尺寸的 T2 舰船之前，就已经开上了大型 T1 舰船（战列巡洋舰或战列舰）。不过这并不是铁律：例如，如果你作为飞行员的目标就是这样，完全可以从 T1 护卫舰直接练到 T2 护卫舰，而从不训练驾驶更大 T1 舰船所需的技能。

blocks.en: Support skills
blocks.zh: 辅助技能

blocks.en: Main article: Support skills
blocks.zh: 主条目：辅助技能

blocks.en: Being able to fly a ship at all and being able to fly a ship well can be two very different things. While the relevant spaceship command skill may let you enter a ship and undock it from a station, this is only the first step to using the ship properly. In addition to the skills you will need to fit all of the guns and modules you want to use (fitting skills), there is an entire suite of support skills that can cumulatively boost a hull's performance. Some of these benefit most or all ships that you can fly, making them valuable training choices.
blocks.zh: 能开一艘船和能把一艘船开好可能是两回事。相关的飞船操控技能可以让你坐进船里并离站，但这只是正确使用舰船的第一步。除了装配你想用的所有武器和装备所需的技能（装配技能）之外，还有一整套辅助技能可以累积提升舰体的性能。其中一些技能对你能驾驶的大部分甚至全部舰船都有好处，因此是很有价值的训练选择。

blocks.en: As a rule of thumb, smaller and lower-tech ships demand less-polished support and fitting skills from your character. A Tech 1 frigate in the hands of a days-old character can handily complete Level 1 PvE missions or significantly affect veteran pilots in advanced ships by tackling or using electronic warfare in PvP. An expensive Tech 2 black ops battleship, meanwhile, will be a painful loss waiting to happen if piloted by a character without well-trained support skills.
blocks.zh: 经验法则是：越小、科技等级越低的舰船，对角色辅助技能和装配技能的打磨程度要求越低。在一个只有几天大的角色手中，T1 护卫舰也能轻松完成 1 级 PvE 任务，或者在 PvP 中通过拦截或使用电子战，对驾驶高级舰船的老手造成重大影响。而一艘昂贵的 T2 黑隐特勤舰，如果由辅助技能训练不足的角色驾驶，就是一次迟早会发生的惨痛损失。

blocks.en: Small- and medium-sized Tech 1 hulls can take part in most activities in EVE, and even players with high-SP characters often return to these "basic" ships, so new players should bear support skills in mind but should not be daunted by the thought of training them. EVE University's E-Uni CORE Skill Plans might help players plan skill training in the short and long terms.
blocks.zh: 中小型 T1 舰体可以参与 EVE 中的大多数活动，即便是技能点很高的玩家也经常回头开这些“基础”舰船，所以新玩家应当记得辅助技能，但不必被训练它们的想法吓倒。EVE University 的 E-Uni CORE 技能计划可以帮助玩家规划短期和长期的技能训练。

blocks.en: Fitting
blocks.zh: 装配

blocks.en: Main article: Fitting ships
blocks.zh: 主条目：舰船装配

blocks.en: Ships are merely empty hulls waiting to be equipped with the guns and modules that let them do their job. The process of equipping a ship is known as "fitting" the ship and is an expansive topic.
blocks.zh: 舰船本身只是空壳，等待装上武器和装备来完成各自的工作。为舰船装备的过程称为“装配”，这是一个内容庞大的话题。

blocks.en: However, one basic concept is worth mentioning here as it ties into the ship sizes listed earlier. The ship sizes are grouped into small, medium, large, or X-large. When browsing the market, you will notice that modules and weapons are also grouped into these same sizes. When fitting a ship, you normally want to use modules and weapons that are in the same size grouping as the ship size. This can sometimes be confusing, especially with weapon systems, as many items may say "medium" in the name, but belong to the "small" size group in the market categories. What matters for ship fitting is that the market category size group matches the ship size, not any terms found in the item name itself.
blocks.zh: 不过，有一个基本概念值得在这里一提，因为它与前面列出的舰船尺寸有关。舰船尺寸分为小型、中型、大型和超大型。浏览市场时你会注意到，装备和武器也按同样的尺寸分组。装配舰船时，通常应当使用与舰船尺寸同组的装备和武器。这有时会让人困惑，尤其是武器系统，因为很多物品名字里写着“中型”，但在市场分类里却属于“小型”尺寸组。对舰船装配来说，重要的是市场分类中的尺寸组与舰船尺寸匹配，而不是物品名称里的字眼。

blocks.en: Categorization
blocks.zh: 分类

blocks.en: Ships can be categorized in many ways, and this section will cover the most basic methods. The examples given are not a complete representation of ships in EVE. It should be noted, however, that more expensive or bigger doesn't always mean better in EVE.
blocks.zh: 舰船可以用很多方式分类，本节介绍最基本的几种方法。所举例子并不能完整代表 EVE 中的所有舰船。不过需要注意的是，在 EVE 中更贵或更大并不总是意味着更好。

blocks.en: Size Class
blocks.zh: 尺寸级别

blocks.en: An Avatar, one of the largest ships in EVE. Almost 14 kilometers in length, it is over 200 times longer than the Punisher, a frigate.
blocks.zh: 神使级，EVE 中最大的舰船之一。它长近 14 公里，是护卫舰惩罚者级长度的 200 多倍。

blocks.en: As ships increase in size they gain more hitpoints, potential damage output, and module slots. They lose agility, speed, and the ability to apply damage to smaller, faster targets. The sizes (with a few example ships) are as follows:
blocks.zh: 随着舰船尺寸增大，它们会获得更多的耐久值、潜在伤害输出和装备槽位，但会失去灵活性、速度，以及对更小更快目标施加伤害的能力。各尺寸（附部分示例舰船）如下：

zh: 护卫舰：因卡萨斯级、苍鹭级、磨难级、爆发级
驱逐舰：阿尔格斯级、渡鸦级、强制者级、长尾鲛级
巡洋舰：托勒克斯级、狞獾级、暴君级、镰刀级
战列巡洋舰：弥洱米顿级、猛鲑级、先驱者级、暴风级
战列舰：万王宝座级、鹏鲲级、地狱天使级、狂暴级
旗舰：长须鲸级、安莎尔级、渡神级
航空母舰：绝念级、奇美拉级、执政官级、尼铎格尔级
无畏舰：莫洛级、凤凰级、神示级、纳迦法级
战力辅助舰：使徒级、龙鸟级、尼纳苏级、利夫级
超级旗舰
超级航母：夜神级、飞龙级、万古级、冥府级
泰坦：俄洛巴斯级、勒维亚坦级、神使级、拉格纳洛克级

blocks.en: Some ships that don't fit or are hard to pin down in this classification are certain Haulers and ORE Ships. As indicated above, carriers, dreadnoughts, Force Auxiliaries, supercarriers, titans, and the Rorqual are commonly further grouped together as capitals. The other ships are therefore referred to as "sub-capitals".
blocks.zh: 有些舰船不太符合或难以归入这一分类，比如某些运载舰和联合矿业（ORE）舰船。如上所示，航空母舰、无畏舰、战力辅助舰、超级航母、泰坦以及长须鲸级通常被进一步统称为旗舰。因此，其他舰船被称为“亚旗舰”（sub-capitals）。

blocks.en: Tech 1 ship class comparison table
blocks.zh: T1 舰船级别对比表

blocks.en: This table is meant to provide a basic comparison of ship classes, showing how, for example, "bigger is slower, but has more fitting slots". Characteristics that vary widely have been omitted. For example, bonuses can make drone capacity or scan resolution much higher or lower on one kind of cruiser than another. These often turn out to be the characteristics that define unique uses for ships within a class, making a given ship "a drone cruiser", "an EWAR cruiser", "an exploration cruiser", and so on.
blocks.zh: 此表旨在对各舰船级别进行基本比较，展示诸如“越大越慢，但装配槽位越多”之类的规律。差异很大的属性已被略去。例如，加成可以让某种巡洋舰的无人机容量或扫描分辨率远高于或远低于另一种。这些属性往往正是决定同级别舰船独特用途的特征，使某艘船成为“无人机巡洋舰”“电子战巡洋舰”“探索巡洋舰”等等。

blocks.en: Tech levels and factions
blocks.zh: 科技等级与势力

blocks.en: An Imperial Navy Slicer, a navy ship which is a common sight an areas with small gang and solo PvP activity.
blocks.zh: 帝国海军切割机级，一艘海军舰船，在小队和单人 PvP 活跃的区域很常见。

blocks.en: "Tech levels" refer to the complexity and rarity of the materials required to build a ship. Tech 1 ships are cheap and simple, but reliable; Tech 2 ships are expensive, powerful, but specialized; Tech 3 ships are expensive and highly flexible.
blocks.zh: “科技等级”指建造舰船所需材料的复杂程度和稀有程度。T1 舰船便宜、简单但可靠；T2 舰船昂贵、强大但专精；T3 舰船昂贵且极其灵活。

blocks.en: "Faction" origins indicate the NPC group within EVE responsible for the ship design. The standard ships of the four main NPC empires—Minmatar, Amarr, Gallente and Caldari—are the mainstay of the game and the most commonly-encountered. "Navy" ships are tuned-up, improved, and more expensive versions of existing hulls designed for the four empires' military forces. "Pirate" ships are hulls developed by outlaw groups such as the Guristas Pirates or paramilitaries such as Mordu's Legion. Sisters of EVE ships are considered "pirate" ships although the Sisters are not a criminal organization.
blocks.zh: “势力”出身表示 EVE 中负责该舰船设计的 NPC 组织。四大 NPC 帝国——米玛塔尔、艾玛、盖伦特和加达里——的标准舰船是游戏的主力，也是最常见的舰船。“海军”舰船是为四大帝国军队设计的、在现有舰体基础上强化改进且更昂贵的版本。“海盗”舰船是由古斯塔斯海盗等非法组织或莫德军团等准军事组织开发的舰体。EVE 姐妹会的舰船也被视为“海盗”舰船，尽管姐妹会并不是犯罪组织。

blocks.en: Here are some examples:
blocks.zh: 以下是一些例子：

en: Navy Faction: Brutix Navy Issue, Raven Navy Issue, Imperial Navy Slicer, Republic Fleet Firetail
zh: T1：因卡萨斯级、渡鸦级、启示级、暴风级
海军势力：布鲁提克斯级海军型、乌鸦级海军型、帝国海军切割机级、共和舰队火尾鸡级
海盗势力：警惕级、毒蜥级、巴戈龙级、德拉米尔级
T2：伊什塔级、战鹰级、帕拉丁级、斯雷普尼级
T3：赫卡特级、金鹏级、忏悔者级、洛基级

blocks.en: Tech 1 ships are the baseline for all other ships. Although they are the first ships every character uses, they remain useful even for advanced pilots. They are easily built with knowledge available to everyone in New Eden, using widely-available materials. They are cheap, and they insure quite well.
blocks.zh: T1 舰船是所有其他舰船的基准。虽然它们是每个角色最先使用的舰船，但即使对资深飞行员也依然有用。它们使用新伊甸人人可得的知识和随处可得的材料就能轻松建造。它们很便宜，保险赔付也相当划算。

blocks.en: Navy faction ships are generally amped-up versions of their Tech 1 counterparts, usually with more CPU and powergrid for fitting, and a few more slots for modules. They typically sit somewhere between base Tech 1 hulls and Tech 2 hulls in their capabilities. Sometimes the base hull's bonuses are traded for others so, for example, the Drake Navy Issue which trades the Drake's damage resistance for better damage application. In some cases the hull's role changes: the Scythe is designed to boost other ships' shields, while the Scythe Fleet Issue is a damage-dealer. Navy ships are harder to acquire than their base hull equivalents, and accordingly are more expensive on the open market.
blocks.zh: 海军势力舰船一般是对应 T1 舰船的强化版，通常有更多用于装配的 CPU 和能量栅格，以及多出几个装备槽位。它们的能力通常介于基础 T1 舰体和 T2 舰体之间。有时会把基础舰体的加成换成别的加成，例如幼龙级海军型就用幼龙级的伤害抗性加成换取了更好的伤害投射。某些情况下舰体的定位会发生变化：镰刀级设计用来给其他舰船回复护盾，而镰刀级舰队型则是输出舰。海军舰船比对应的基础舰体更难获得，因此在公开市场上也更贵。

blocks.en: Pirate faction ships represent a greater advance on the abilities of base Tech 1 hulls. They require two separate spaceship command skills for different factions so, for example, the Angel Cartel Cynabal requires training in both Minmatar Cruiser and Gallente Cruiser. In return, though, each pirate hull has more powerful and unusual bonuses which often make them fly in surprising ways. The Gurista Gila, for example, launches only two drones, but can use those two to deal damage equivalent to ten drones. Similarly, the Serpentis Vindicator offers a unique combination of a stasis webifier bonus and massive damage output. Pirate faction ships are roughly as powerful as Tech 2 ships, and require fewer skills. They are accordingly very expensive.
blocks.zh: 海盗势力舰船在基础 T1 舰体的能力上有更大的提升。它们需要两个不同势力的飞船操控技能，例如天使企业联合体的塞纳波级需要同时训练米玛塔尔巡洋舰操作和盖伦特巡洋舰操作。但作为回报，每种海盗舰体都有更强大、更特别的加成，往往让它们的玩法出人意料。例如古斯塔斯的毒蜥级只能放出两架无人机，但这两架就能打出相当于十架无人机的伤害。同样，天蛇的复仇者级兼具停滞缠绕光束加成和巨大的伤害输出，组合独一无二。海盗势力舰船的强度大致与 T2 舰船相当，所需技能更少，因此价格非常昂贵。

blocks.en: Tech 2 ships are built by retrofitting Tech 1 ships, and while they take some features from their Tech 1 forms, the ways they fly and take advantage of fitting may be very different. They have higher resistance to damage and are typically much more specialized in their roles. Many special modules can only be fit on Tech 2 ships. The heavy Interdictor is a prime example of a Tech 2 ship filling a specialized role: it can use a special module to stop ships within a wide area from warping away—a unique ability—but it has more limited abilities in other areas. Tech 2 ships are powerful within their niches but are not automatically better than Tech 1 ships, or immune to attack from Tech 1 ships. Tech 2 ships require extensive skill training to fly but can be less expensive than Pirate Faction ships due to their simpler production.
blocks.zh: T2 舰船是通过改造 T1 舰船建造的，虽然保留了 T1 形态的一些特点，但它们的飞法和对装配的利用方式可能大不相同。它们拥有更高的伤害抗性，在定位上通常更加专精。许多特殊装备只能装在 T2 舰船上。重型拦截巡洋舰就是 T2 舰船担任专门职能的典型例子：它可以使用一种特殊装备，阻止大范围内的舰船跃迁离开——这是独有的能力——但在其他方面能力较为有限。T2 舰船在各自的细分领域内很强，但并不会自动比 T1 舰船更好，也不会对 T1 舰船的攻击免疫。T2 舰船需要大量技能训练才能驾驶，但由于生产更简单，价格可能比海盗势力舰船便宜。

blocks.en: Tech 3 ships were developed by the four empire factions by reverse-engineering Sleeper technology. They are known for their powerful defenses and great versatility, which come from a very wide variety of innate hull bonuses, generous fitting layouts, and unique ways to completely transform themselves on-the-fly. All materials required for Tech 3 ships come from wormhole space. As an example, a Legion can be fitted to be a heavily armored neuting ship, a heavy assault missile boat, or a more traditional laser boat; and may be active tanked, buffer tanked, or even able to cloak itself. Similarly, a Hecate can switch between different modes which can harden its defenses, increase its mobility, or let it deal damage at longer ranges.
blocks.zh: T3 舰船是四大帝国势力通过逆向工程冬眠者科技开发出来的。它们以强大的防御和极高的多功能性著称，这得益于种类繁多的舰体固有加成、宽裕的装配布局，以及能够在飞行中彻底改变自身形态的独特方式。T3 舰船所需的全部材料都来自虫洞空间。例如，圣卒级可以装配成重甲中和船、重型突击导弹船或更传统的激光船；可以走主动坦、缓冲坦，甚至能够隐形。同样，赫卡特级可以在不同模式之间切换，从而强化防御、提升机动性，或者让它在更远的距离上输出伤害。

blocks.en: Other factions
blocks.zh: 其他势力

blocks.en: CONCORD, EDENCOM, the Society of Conscious Thought, and the Triglavian Collective all also have ships of their own. These ships follow completely different mechanics and skill sets than other ships and do not fit into the traditional tech and faction levels.
blocks.zh: 统合部、伊甸联合防御阵线、理性思维社团和三神裔也都有各自的舰船。这些舰船遵循与其他舰船完全不同的机制和技能体系，不属于传统的科技等级和势力分级。

en: CONCORD offers a trio of extremely flexible, extremely skill-intensive, highly-militarized covert ops ships.
EDENCOM offers a curious, but very difficult to utilize, set of ships with "chain lightning" damage-dealing abilities.
The Triglavian Collective offers a wide selection of ships that utilize unique ramping-over-time weapons that can burn down targets well above their weight class.
The SoCT offers a set of three ships with nearly limitless versatility and no skill requirements, offering new and veteran players alike a set of flexible hulls.
zh: 统合部提供三艘极其灵活、对技能要求极高、高度军事化的隐秘行动舰。
伊甸联合防御阵线提供一套很有意思但非常难用的舰船，具备“连锁闪电”伤害能力。
三神裔提供多种舰船，使用独特的随时间递增伤害的武器，可以击毁远超自身量级的目标。
理性思维社团（SoCT）提供三艘几乎无所不能、且没有技能要求的舰船，为新老玩家提供了一套灵活的舰体。

blocks.en: Non-combat ships
blocks.zh: 非战斗舰船

blocks.en: A Charon, prized for its gigantic cargo hold.
blocks.zh: 渡神级，以其巨大的货柜舱而备受青睐。

blocks.en: Not all ships are designed for aggressive action. A subset of ships with increased efficiency in resource-gathering and cargo hauling are in wide use across the EVE universe. Here is a loose listing of these ships.
blocks.zh: 并非所有舰船都是为进攻而设计的。有一类在资源采集和货物运输方面效率更高的舰船，在整个 EVE 宇宙中被广泛使用。以下是这些舰船的大致列表。

blocks.en: Haulers
blocks.zh: 运载舰

blocks.en: Main article: Haulers
blocks.zh: 主条目：运载舰

blocks.en: Haulers have large cargo capacities and are used to haul goods from place to place. Some are even more specialized, having an extra capacity for items such as ore, minerals or weapons. The smallest class of cargo ships, Tech 1 Haulers, are lightly defended and fly mostly among high security systems.
blocks.zh: 运载舰拥有很大的货柜容量，用于把货物从一个地方运到另一个地方。有些还更加专门化，拥有用于矿石、矿物或武器等物品的额外舱容。最小一级的货船——T1 运载舰——防御薄弱，主要在高安星系之间航行。

zh: T1：伊特龙级MKV、獾级、猛犸级

blocks.en: Tech 2 haulers are divided between Blockade Runners, which are fast and can cloak for stealth in dangerous space, and Deep Space Transports, which have stronger defenses. Each empire faction has one of each kind of Tech 2 hauler.
blocks.zh: T2 运载舰分为两种：偷运舰速度快，可以隐形以便在危险空间中潜行；深层空间运输舰则拥有更强的防御。每个帝国势力各有一艘这两种 T2 运载舰。

zh: T2 偷运舰：天鹤级、旅行者级
T2 深层空间运输舰：巨象级、激进级

blocks.en: Freighters
blocks.zh: 货舰

blocks.en: Main article: Freighters
blocks.zh: 主条目：货舰

blocks.en: Freighters are the largest cargo ships in EVE. These slow-moving hulks have no high or medium equipment slots and depend entirely on their massive hulls for defense. In general, if you can package an item, you can fit it into the cargo hold of a Tech 1 freighter.
blocks.zh: 货舰是 EVE 中最大的货船。这些行动缓慢的庞然大物没有高槽和中槽，完全依靠其巨大的舰体来防御。一般来说，只要物品能打包，就能装进 T1 货舰的货柜舱。

zh: T1：渡神级、芬利厄级、方尖塔级、普罗维登斯级

blocks.en: Tech 2 freighters are called Jump Freighters. They have smaller cargo bays than Tech 1 freighters but can use both jump gates and cynosural fields. The latter makes them especially useful in null sec.
blocks.zh: T2 货舰称为战略货舰。它们的货柜舱比 T1 货舰小，但既能使用星门，也能利用诱导力场跳跃。后者让它们在 00 区格外有用。

zh: T2（战略货舰）：安莎尔级、方舟级、奥鸟级、游牧者级

blocks.en: Miners
blocks.zh: 采矿船

blocks.en: While not intended for combat, ships bonused for mining can mount light weapons or carry drones suitable for defense against belt pirates.
blocks.zh: 具有采矿加成的舰船虽然并非为战斗设计，但也可以装备轻型武器或携带无人机，足以防御矿带里的海盗 NPC。

zh: T1：冲锋者级

blocks.en: The Mining Barges are usually the next step in the mining profession. Each of the three is bonused for a specific use in asteroid mining.
blocks.zh: 采矿驳船通常是采矿生涯的下一步。三种采矿驳船各自针对小行星采矿的特定用途有加成。

zh: T1：回旋者级、妄想级、猎获级

blocks.en: The Exhumers are the top of the line in specialized ore extractors. As with the Mining Barges, each is bonused for a specific use.
blocks.zh: 采掘者是专业矿石采集船中的顶级型号。和采矿驳船一样，每种都针对特定用途有加成。

zh: T2：霍克级、轻舟级、麦基诺级

blocks.en: The Expedition Frigates specialize in ice and gas harvesting.
blocks.zh: 勘探护卫舰专精于冰矿和气云采集。

zh: T2：掘金者级、永恒者级

blocks.en: Specialty Ships
blocks.zh: 特种舰船

en: Porpoise: The Porpoise is a mining command ship, bringing a larger cargo bay than other mining ships and the ability to improve the mining speeds of nearby allies.
Orca: The big brother of the Porpoise, a much larger, more capable, and more resilient mining command platform, which also features an enormous cargo bay that lets it also act as a hauling ship.
Noctis: The final word in salvaging, able to fit up to 8 high-power salvagers or long-range tractor beams.

Rorqual: The Capital Industrial Ship, the dreadnought and carrier of mining, and the final word in mining command. Extremely capable at mining, mining fleet support, defensive combat, and cargo hauling. Cannot be used in high-security space, very powerful in low- and null-security space.

Sisters of EVE: the four SOE ships (Astero, Stratios, Nestor, Odysseus) are optimized for exploration. Each is bonused for scanning and hacking, and each has sufficient combat strength to either run PvE combat sites or hunt other exploration ships. They require both Amarr and Gallente spaceship skills, and to be used effectively they require solid scanning, drone skills, and armor skills. Nestor has also a very distinct niche in game as a logistics battleship, that is used in a small fleet activities.
zh: 海豚级：海豚级是一艘采矿指挥舰，货柜舱比其他采矿船更大，还能提升附近友方的采矿速度。
逆戟鲸级：海豚级的大哥，是一个更大、更强、更耐打的采矿指挥平台，还拥有一个巨大的货柜舱，使它也能充当运输船。
黑夜级：打捞领域的终极之选，最多可装配 8 个高槽打捞器或远程牵引光束。
长须鲸级：旗舰级工业舰，相当于采矿界的无畏舰和航空母舰，也是采矿指挥的终极之选。在采矿、采矿舰队支援、防御作战和货物运输方面都极为出色。不能在高安空间使用，在低安和 00 区空间非常强大。
EVE 姐妹会：四艘姐妹会舰船（阿斯特罗级、斯特修斯级、涅斯托级、奥德修斯级）专为探索优化。每艘都有扫描和破解加成，并且都具备足够的战斗力，既能刷 PvE 战斗站点，也能猎杀其他探索船。它们需要艾玛和盖伦特两系的飞船技能，想要用好还需要扎实的扫描、无人机和装甲技能。涅斯托级在游戏中还有一个非常独特的定位——后勤战列舰，用于小规模舰队活动。
